description: Poll a purchase created by buy_credits using the agent-held session_id and claim_token. While ready is false, wait retry_after_seconds before retrying (up to 15 minutes). Once the human has paid, returns the API key for the agent to store securely and use in the MCP connection or REST Authorization header. Keep the claim token out of the browser; key retrieval can be retried from the same IP for 15 minutes after the first successful claim.
name: claim_purchase
title: Claim Purchased StoreTechScan Credits
